data.name: Atworth
data.gender_notes: Atworth is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English at meaning 'at' and worth meaning 'worth'. It suggests a man of great value or worth. The name Atworth carries the meaning “Man's worth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atworth usually hope their child will grow to embody man's worth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of one's intrinsic worth in the eyes of God.
data.etymology: Atworth belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man's worth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atworth total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Ultimately, the name Atworth invites us to embrace the gifts and talents we have been given and to use them to make a positive impact on the world around us.
